record-behavior-create.goal: Freeze a matched API behavioral experiment, observable criterion, route and call budget; does not run a model.

record-behavior-observe.goal: Record explicitly unverified, caller-reported API observations. Does not establish internal model state or improvement.

record-experience-compare.goal: Record a provisional critic comparison tied to two actual image artifacts; does not claim user preference.

record-experience-investigate.goal: Preserve an explicit hypothesis and proposed experiment without claiming the experiment ran.

record-experience-note.goal: After work, preserve a small proposed lesson, applicability conditions, invalidation rules and existing evidence paths. Requires learning enabled; does not establish truth or authority.

record-experience-trace.goal: Append a timestamped reported interaction observation with references; not an independently verified journey.

record-experiment-create.goal: Preserve an isolated experiment snapshot and declared recipes; does not execute recipes.

record-experiment-restore.goal: Restore an intact experiment into a new isolated directory, refusing overwrite.

record-orchestration-compile.goal: Compile a compact NEYVIA/1 program into a validated dependency graph with runtime, permission, budget, and proof contracts.

outputPath.description: Optional screenshot path inside the active workspace. Omit to use the managed artifact path.

record-quality-challenge.goal: Persist a proposed examination challenge pending operator review. Arguments: holdout, proposal.

record-quality-compare.goal: Apply the same frozen instrument to real baseline and candidate artifacts. Arguments: instrument, baseline, candidate.

record-quality-examine.goal: Run all frozen examination instruments on supplied artifact targets. Arguments: holdout, targets.

record-quality-holdout.goal: Seal an immutable examination with an instruments list. Arguments: i, spec.

record-quality-instrument.goal: Seal a json_numeric, image or trace_timing instrument specification. Arguments: i, spec.

record-quality-measure.goal: Measure an actual scoped artifact and preserve a receipt. Arguments: instrument, target.

record-taste-correction.goal: Record a provisional contextual correction from real before/after artifacts. Arguments: context, before_path, after_path, correction.

pitfalls.failure: A reported observation is mistaken for actual provider/model quality
pitfalls.recovery: Keep evidenceVerified false and use a separately authorized real provider journey.

pitfalls.failure: A frozen source, instrument or saved record changes
pitfalls.recovery: Completion is refused; inspect the owning source and create a new explicit trial.

frontier: No provider model is invoked. No general quality, operator taste or skill improvement is established.
Dependency provisioning, host rehearsal and skill mutation require their own fresh execution witness.
guidance: Enable applicable collaboration preferences through the operator seam before a trial.
Instrument criteria establish exactly the measured local artifact property. Preserve failed measurements.
